newsitem.title: CANADA: Hees, Edper holders approve merger.
newsitem.headline: Hees, Edper holders approve merger.

text.p: Hees International Bancorp Inc said that its shareholders and the shareholders of Edper Group Ltd had approved a merger of the two companies.

As a result of the merger, Edper shareholders will receive 0.38 class A limited voting shares of the newly merged company for each class A non-voting share held and common shareholders of Hees will receive one class A limited voting share of the amalgamated company for each Hees share.
The company said in a statement released late on Thursday the merger will take effect on January 1, 1997 and will carry on under the name The Edper Group Ltd.
